ros_sunray_adapter_route: PX4CTRL_CORE_PROFILE=dfbc_high_order through Fast-Drone-250 px4ctrl LinearControl wrapper and MAVROS setpoint_raw/attitude

source_references.path: Docs/Paper/A Comparative Study of Nonlinear MPC and Differential-Flatness-Based Control for Quadrotor Agile Flight.pdf
source_references.evidence: Paper motivates comparing NMPC and differential-flatness control for agile flight, with INDI inner loop and drag-model improvements. It requires Gazebo/runtime A/B before any performance claim.
Public UZH/RPG control stack route for the first paper family; use as upstream implementation reference before hand-writing deeper NMPC/DFBC/INDI changes.
Author-group quadrotor control reference linked to the Agilicious/RPG ecosystem; useful for geometric/flatness controller semantics and control-chain comparison.
Author-group MPC reference linked to the Agilicious/RPG ecosystem; use for later NMPC-side reproduction rather than inventing a solver route from memory.
Diff-Planner publishes PositionCommand with jerk and yaw_dot; current MoSim wrapper can read jerk but not snap from this message path.
Command_Data_t reads position, velocity, acceleration, jerk, yaw and yaw_rate from quadrotor_msgs/PositionCommand.
LinearControl supports PX4CTRL_CORE_PROFILE=dfbc_high_order and maps core desired attitude/thrust to the MAVROS ATTITUDE_THRUST path while exposing desired_body_rate in debug fields.
Fast-Drone trajectory server publishes p/v/a/yaw/yaw_dot; it is a conservative reference for the first runtime route.
EGO-Planner-v2 tracking route publishes p/v/a/yaw/yaw_dot; high-order snap availability is not assumed.

implemented_control_law: Compute flat-output feedback acceleration from p/v/a/yaw using the same ATTITUDE_THRUST projection path as DFBC Basic.
Compute desired_body_rate diagnostic/feedforward from reference jerk and yaw_rate.
Compute desired_body_acceleration diagnostic/feedforward from reference snap and yaw_acceleration when provided by the caller.
Clamp high-order body-rate and body-acceleration diagnostics using profile parameters.
current_limitations: Current runtime output remains MAVROS ATTITUDE_THRUST, so desired_body_rate and desired_body_acceleration are not yet a separate BODY_RATE_THRUST or torque-level command path.
Diff-Planner and the current px4ctrl Command_Data_t path provide jerk and yaw_rate but not an explicit snap field; snap is zero unless a future trajectory/source path adds it.
This is a paper-route engineering candidate, not a validated reproduction of the paper's agile-flight metrics.
The paper's INDI inner-loop and aerodynamic-drag-model improvements are separate G10/G11 candidates unless explicitly integrated and measured.
first_runtime_ab_required: Diff-Planner three-UAV only after single-UAV passes
known_failure_modes: No measured improvement is expected if the high-order fields are only diagnostics and the actual command remains attitude/thrust.
Nonzero jerk from planner may increase attitude transients if the attitude loop cannot track the implied body-rate dynamics.
Snap-dependent angular acceleration is unavailable in the current PositionCommand route.
Aggressive trajectories can saturate tilt or thrust before any high-order benefit appears.
forbidden_claims: INDI inner loop or drag model implemented
